text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to do my best cleaning the 
room~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we still have time until the pajama 
party, so no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Just thinking about Messiah-san 
and Heart-san coming got me so excited.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll start with the desk first. Time 
to put away all the stuff I left lying 
around!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, all sorts of things have fallen into 
the back of the drawer... Ah!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Do you remember this? It's the 
candy wrapper Cesario gave us!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. When I was prepping for a 
sports nutrition presentation, Cesario 
brought me some refreshments, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's right...! You saved it for me? 
What a surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Throwing it away would be such a waste!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. When you brought snacks 
over, didn't you end up helping me make 
presentation materials too?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Craft was trying so hard. I just couldn't 
help wanting to lend a hand♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hey Craft, do you remember this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! From when I gave you that bracelet! 
You kept the box for it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It matches the pattern on my 
handmade bracelet, so I just couldn't 
throw it out♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yep, we match! When I spotted the box at 
the shop, I let out a huge "Aaaah!" 
without thinking!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario is so cool and sparkling, so I 
thought blue stars would suit her. That's 
why I put them in the bracelet, too~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened. Hehe, that just 
makes my heart feel even warmer♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, nostalgic! It's my study guide 
notebook from midterms!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is a note we passed during class! 
Hehe, what were we talking about again...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Takes me back~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Takes me back~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no! It's pitch black outside the 
window!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~~!! I took it way too easy!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...There's still time. Craft, I'll direct 
the cleaning order. We are definitely 
finishing this before the pajama party!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "On"-mode Cesario...! Yeah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—...And so, yesterday was just one chaotic 
mess after another.
choice_data_list: I see. Did you finish cleaning in time?
I see. Did you finish cleaning in time?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, somehow or other. Though we ended up 
having to clean non-stop without a single 
break.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even having to rush around seemed to be 
part of the fun for her. Just listening 
brings a smile to my face.
choice_data_list:
It's nice that you have so many memories 
with Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's true. To be honest, before 
enrolling, I was worried about whether I 
could adapt to life in the dorms, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Because Craft is my roommate, we never 
run out of things to talk about, and I 
never feel lonely."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Turning ordinary days into precious 
treasures, inspiring each other as rivals 
chasing our dreams—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Because Craft is my roommate, I've been 
enjoying a truly fulfilling dorm life♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because they were bound by such 
deep friendship, there were so many 
keepsakes in the dorm room that it brought 
the cleaning to a complete halt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As one who will someday serve as a 
'cornerstone' for future Umamusume, I 
truly hope Cesario nurtures a sound mind 
and body."
choice_data_list:
I hope you'll continue to make wonderful 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll make precious memories with my 
precious friends.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even if it seems trivial right now, when 
they grow up, these memories will surely 
give them the strength to push forward.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
May that strength one day give a push to 
the backs of the Umamusume you guide—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Is saying something like that asking for 
too much?
choice_data_list: Not at all. That's a wonderful wish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Do what can only be done now, in this 
very moment. I felt strongly that I had to 
do everything I could as a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I keep records of my daily 
training and race results. Yet when the 
future arrives, I will also need something 
to bring back the memories of this moment.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see. After all, an athlete's life isn't 
just about training and racing, is it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about we make a new rule? Whenever 
we go on an away trip, we have to buy at 
least one souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If it's something we chose together, we'll 
both be able to look back on the memories. 
It might even be useful for instructing 
future Umamusume♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take out a corkboard that hadn't been in 
use. I'll display memories with Cesario 
here. So that we can remember the present 
in the distant future.
